from itertools import product
C, P, B, N = 1, 2, 4, 8
regions = range(1, 16)
holds = {"I": True, "II": True, "III": True}
for bits in product([0, 1], repeat=len(regions)):
    m = [r for r, b in zip(regions, bits) if b]
    if any(not any(r & s for r in m) for s in (C, P, B, N)):
        continue
    if any(r & C and not r & P for r in m): continue
    if not any(r & P and r & B for r in m): continue
    if any(r & B and not r & N for r in m): continue
    holds["I"] &= any(r & P and r & N for r in m)
    holds["II"] &= not any(r & C and r & B for r in m)
    holds["III"] &= not any(r & C and not r & N for r in m)
result = frozenset(k for k, v in holds.items() if v)
opts = {"A": frozenset({"II", "III"}), "B": frozenset({"I", "II"}), "C": frozenset({"I"}), "D": frozenset({"III"})}

match = [k for k, v in opts.items() if v == result]
assert len(match) == 1
print(f"ANSWER={match[0]}")

fastest: O is the right face in both views, so M, N, K, J ring around O [[f:dice.common-face-opposite]]
View 1 top→front: M→N; view 2: K→J, so the ring is M, N, K, J [[f:dice.cyclic-order]]
Alternate faces are opposite: J opposite **N**

diagram.alt_text: Cube net with O in the centre, M above, N right, K below, J left and L beyond N; N and J are opposite.

full: Both views show O on the right, so the other four visible letters M, N, K, J all touch O and L is opposite O.
Turning the dice about the O–L axis moves top→front→bottom→back in a fixed cycle.
View 1 has M on top and N in front; view 2 has K on top and J in front. The only cycle of M, N, K, J where M is followed by N and K by J is M, N, K, J.
Faces two apart in the cycle are opposite: M–K and N–J. So N is opposite J.
check_code:
from itertools import permutations
views = [("M", "N"), ("K", "J")]   # (top, front) with O fixed on the right
ring_faces = {"M", "N", "K", "J"}
rings = []
for p in permutations(sorted(ring_faces - {"M"})):
    ring = ("M",) + p
    if all(ring[(ring.index(t) + 1) % 4] == f for t, f in views):
        rings.append(ring)
assert len(rings) == 1
ring = rings[0]
result = ring[(ring.index("J") + 2) % 4]
opts = {"A": "N", "B": "M", "C": "O", "D": "L"}

match = [k for k, v in opts.items() if v == result]
assert len(match) == 1
print(f"ANSWER={match[0]}")

fastest: U is on top in both views [[f:dice.common-face-opposite]]
Around U: V then X (view 1), X then Z (view 2) [[f:dice.cyclic-order]]
V, X, Z are consecutive, so V and Z are opposite → **Z**

diagram.alt_text: Cube net with U in the centre, V above, X right, Z below; V and Z are opposite.

full: U is on top in both positions, so the side faces turn around U.
Going clockwise round U, view 1 shows V followed by X.
View 2 shows X followed by Z, so the side order is V, X, Z, then a fourth face.
Faces two apart round U are opposite, so V is opposite Z.

pairs = [("V", "X"), ("X", "Z")]   # (left, right) side faces with U on top

ring = ["V"]
